//globalPassThroughEnv: turbo 2 defaults to a STRICT environment mode: a task receives NODE_OPTIONS and turbo's other built-in system variables, and NOTHING else that is not declared. An undeclared variable is dropped in silence, which is not a hypothetical here — the exit recorder wired into ci.yml's gate step reads this one, and without this line it loaded inside every task (NODE_OPTIONS does survive) and then went inert, so a red Windows run recorded only the two processes running OUTSIDE turbo and none of the ones that died inside it. passThroughEnv rather than globalEnv deliberately: globalEnv would fold the value into every task's hash, so setting it at all would bust the entire cache. The recorder also falls back to an `exit-trace` directory located from its own path, so losing this line degrades rather than silently disarms it; the self-test asserts both routes.
